changes.title: GLOBAL AULAMUS VS KROMEDE
added: Spent time with AionLab (damage formula founder) to crunch numbers on the Aulamus vs Kromede Weapon on the Global servers. We based the tests off of my Gladiator @ 180k CP. These numbers will vary depending on what your stats are and what class you're playing.
If fully maxed and with BIS lines on both weapons, Kromede is better in terms of pure damage but by very little.
2m extra Range (not factored into DPS comparison)
Kromede offers more attack and Damage Boost from Amp levels (excluding the range)
Attack difference of 131 = 3.61% more damage for Kromede
Damage Boost difference = 0.8%~0.9% more damage for Kromede
Aulamus offers an additional stat line, in this case we used Might
Attack Increase 2.9% (29 Might stat line) = 1.87% more damage for Aulamus
When comparing only the attack and damage boost difference, Kromede deals 4.53% more damage
When comparing only the attack increase from Might (2.9%), Aulamus deals 1.87% more damage
When factoring only the attack difference, damage boost difference, and attack increase (extra stat line being Might) difference, Kromede deals 2.61% more damage than Aulamus
AMP 3 Kromede vs Amp 3 Aulamus (extra line being Might for Aulamus), Kromede is better by less than 1%
Note: Kromede wins by less the stronger the character

If Aulamus has either a Damage Boost (2.8%), Weapon Damage Boost (4%), Combat Speed, or Multi-hit (needs more testing but likely as well) line advantage while maintaining its Might Advantage, then Aulamus is better. In other words, if Aulamus has a 2 line advantage it’s better.
In this case, Aulamus is better

Note: You can transfer Aulamus into crafted weapons starting from ILVL 78 White Dragon (tier 2 crafted let’s call it) vs Kromede being able to be transferred starting from ILVL 94 Wise Dragon (tier 3) should you choose to do so.
Note 2: It is very expensive to reroll lines and push from Amp 3 to Amp 5. Remember, Kromede offers 3 stat lines vs Aulamus offering 4 stat lines, vs Crafted offering 5 stat lines at base.

changes.title: HOW STATS WORK (DAMAGE FORMULA)
added: Additional Notes: Combat Speed is a given S-tier individual stat that you stack as much as you can. This, however, is directly impacted by ping and FPS. When tested, a difference of 150-200 ping equated to roughly ≈ 15% ~ 20% damage. Contrary to popular belief, there were no major differences between classes. Templar, Brawler, and Assassin were the three classes tested and were roughly similar. Spiritmaster may be an outlier due to the passive pet damage.
